secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co). Required at boot — the client/server Supabase clients throw without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable (anon) key. Required at boot — used by the browser client and the SSR auth middleware.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role key for server-side admin ops (src/integrations/supabase/client.server.ts): full character load, retry replies. Optional at boot; required for admin/character management.

secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for server-side chat replies (src/lib/ai/provider.ts). Optional at boot; required for the chat AI feature.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Server-side only — checkout session creation + webhook. Get it from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...). Server-side only — verifies the /api/public/stripe-webhook signature. Get it from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks (or `stripe listen --forward-to` for local testing).

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_STARTER
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID (price_...) for the Starter package (9€ one-time, 500 credits). Create the product/price in Stripe Dashboard → Products.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_PREMIUM
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID (price_...) for the Premium package (24€ one-time, 2000 credits). Create the product/price in Stripe Dashboard → Products.

secrets.name: STRIPE_PRICE_VIP
secrets.description: Stripe Price ID (price_...) for the VIP package (59€ one-time, 6000 credits). Create the product/price in Stripe Dashboard → Products.
